Navar nods "the city is desolate, the merrow worship the hunger along with hags. They tried to fight us and we killed as few as we could to respect this is not our place. We found a koi that has a divine soul of sorts that was accompanied by a divine silver liquid, it managed to heal some of florians wounds that he sustained. There also seemed to be a currency of black shells used. We entered the house with the symbol of the kraken that uou had mentioned, I believe it was their noble icon so the creature holds reverence. Deeper in the palace we found with the merrow we arrived at our find, note had seemed determined to get to the bottom as well for some reason. There was an obelisk to osiris that left us a dreadful message of deeper dwelling and a gate to terrible horrors. We unfortunately met one we had to kill, demonic and eldritch. It wounded florian and was swifter than we coukd have imagined. After the dust had settled there was where we found the gods who perished: my lady, ilmater, lythander and kord. There were other items in the hold and by the obelisk were nobles who seemed to have starved, likely holed in their own estate with no way out. I do not know if that was the work of the hunger or the merrow.

Rest assured we did not seek out conflict and the nights, baring rigatony, only took currency and what we had come to reclaim."(i think i got that right. Copper woukd know better. Navar was occupies grieving.)
